# CCH Automotive Sdn Bhd

> Automotive repair shop and Continental car specialist in Likas Baharu, Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia. "Professional in Conti Car", with more than 10 years of experience.

- Address: Lot 5, Batu 5½, Jalan Tuaran, Likas Baharu, 88450 Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia (The Jalan Tuaran Bypass area)
- WhatsApp and phone: +60 10-935 9391 (https://wa.me/60109359391)
- Email: cchautomotive6@gmail.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100083124710565
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Lot%205%2C%20Batu%205%C2%BD%2C%20Jalan%20Tuaran%2C%20Likas%20Baharu%2C%2088450%20Kota%20Kinabalu%2C%20Sabah
- Makes: Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Volkswagen and other makes shown in our work photos
- Engine oil: Alpine Germany engine oil
- Opening hours: not published; WhatsApp to arrange a time

## Services
- [Car troubleshooting](https://cchautomotive.my/services/car-troubleshooting/): Warning lights, odd noises and faults that come and go.
- [Engine and gearbox repair](https://cchautomotive.my/services/engine-gearbox-repair/): Engine faults, gearbox and transmission work, mountings.
- [Computer diagnostics](https://cchautomotive.my/services/computer-diagnostics/): Reading the car's systems to find what is really wrong.
- [Module programming and coding](https://cchautomotive.my/services/module-programming-coding/): Programming modules and coding features on European cars.
- [Car service and maintenance](https://cchautomotive.my/services/car-service-maintenance/): Oil changes with Alpine Germany oil, filters and fluids.
- [Aircond service and repair](https://cchautomotive.my/services/aircond-service-repair/): Aircond not cold? Service, repair and cooling coil work.
- [Electrical and hybrid](https://cchautomotive.my/services/electrical-hybrid/): Electrical faults and hybrid cars, as listed on our flyer.

## Languages
English at the site root, Bahasa Melayu at /ms/, Simplified Chinese at /zh/. Every page exists in all three.
